description: Bus command to archive a resource and optionally remove its file.

correlationId.description: Correlation id for request/reply matching, set by the SDK's busRequest so the confirmed-write ack/failure routes back.

_userId.description: Authenticated user's DID, injected by the /bus/emit gateway. Clients do not set this.

storageUri.description: Optional: where the resource's bytes live, so the archive can act on the file. An instruction to this handler, not a copy of the stored fact (that lives on the primary Representation). Working-tree URI, only file:// is supported.
